summary: A seller sends a screenshot showing a setting for driving on the other side of the road. It looks reassuring: select the option, collect the car, and carry on. Yet the screenshot answers only a narrow question about a menu. It does not establish whether the fitted lamps, their operating modes and their resulting beam meet the destination's requirements for the intended import and registration route.
